title: HtmlCanvas
responsibility: Renders the native canvas element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlCanvas.attributes
inputs.description: Native canvas attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlCanvas.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native canvas element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlCanvas
outputs.description: The actual native canvas element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
